purpose: Give Universal Creation real deterministic workshop calipers over exact sticker geometry: measure actual triangle-referenced GLB POSITION vertices through stored node, assembly, anchor, offset and scale transforms; report local socket-frame bounds and dimensions for nested reusable parts; and combine those measurements with Design Workshop placement evidence without turning numeric bounds into fit, collision, physics or aesthetic claims.

properties.database: local UC sticker SQLite registry; relative paths must stay in creations/.axm-build or may be outside the machine body
properties.sketch: exact axm.design-sketch/v0.1 body; numeric dimension comparison requires units exactly m

contains: actual indexed TRIANGLES POSITION evidence instead of accessor min/max claims
bounds and XYZ dimensions in metres
per-direct-part bounds measured in each part's own sticker socket frame
nested assembly and multiplied-wrapper transforms flattened exactly
combined placement plus actual-size PASS/FAIL/HOLD evidence against an exact sketch

relationships: closes the deliberate source-mesh-size HOLD left by Workshop Construction Loop
reuses UC's existing GLB geometry and pose validation machinery instead of inventing metadata-only dimensions
measures multiplied stickers and nested modules as ordinary reusable sticker assemblies
keeps dimensional evidence separate from fit, clearance, physics and visual approval

implementation.source: src/axm_uc/sticker_geometry_calipers.py via src/axm_uc/__init__.py registration; matching JSON operations are exposed through src/axm_uc/sticker_create.py

limitations: v0.1 measures the authored/default rest pose; it does not compute swept animation envelopes
only ordinary indexed or non-indexed TRIANGLES geometry supported by the existing rigid GLB observer can become complete PASS evidence
sketch dimension comparison requires units exactly m; no implicit unit conversion is guessed
dimension mismatch is reported but this wave does not silently scale, deform or replace source geometry
bounds do not prove contact, collision clearance, strength, manufacturability, physics, aesthetics, engine acceptance or runtime performance

truth.basis: Bounds are derived from actual triangle-referenced vertex bytes plus exact stored transforms; unsupported or incomplete geometry holds/fails rather than trusting metadata or guessing units.

agency.basis: Measurement is read-only; the caller chooses the exact sticker/assembly/sketch and no geometry or assembly state is silently repaired.

continuity.basis: Every report binds exact immutable sticker pins and report digests while nested source assets remain content-addressed and unchanged.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Animation envelopes, unit conversions, unsupported geometry and physical-fit conclusions stay explicit gaps instead of being inferred from a bounding box.
